hook: Your sponge might be the grossest thing in your kitchen.
doThis: Squeeze it dry, every single time.

steps.say: Rinse the food bits out in hot water.
Wring it out hard after every use.
Stand it up to dry, never in a puddle.
Once a week, run it through a hot dishwasher cycle.

safety.say: Still smelly? Bin it. And never mix cleaners.
